guideWelcomeBody: A few quick tips before you start. Pick your language above, or skip straight to the app.
guideBrowseBody: Use Home, Catalogue and Schedule to browse Anime Sama. Your profile lives under Your Space. Ctrl+K opens quick access; click outside it or press Esc to close. Ctrl+B collapses the sidebar to its icons.
guideLibraryBody: The star only appears on anime pages. Your library groups favorites by show and adds cover previews. The wide Resume banner opens your last episode. Compatible players also restore your saved playback position.
guideAppearanceBody: Settings → Personalization has colors, gradients, images and video backgrounds, with blur and brightness controls. Background videos are muted. The pause-during-playback switch only pauses them while you watch; turn it off to keep them moving. Reduce motion limits animation.
guideDiscordBody: Open desktop Discord to connect RPC. Settings → Discord RPC lets you hide titles or episodes, or turn sharing off. Watch and About open Samani if it’s installed, otherwise the website. Your browser may ask for confirmation. The presence also shows when playback is paused.
guideWatchBody: Cinema mode is available only on an episode page. Use its bottom-bar control or Ctrl+Shift+F; Esc brings the sidebar back. F11 toggles fullscreen. Under Settings → Desktop you can keep Samani on top, start at login, or close to the system tray.
guideUpdatesBody: Settings → Update checks for new versions. Setup can download an update and restart to install it. Portable and ZIP builds need manual replacement. Your choices are saved automatically. Enjoy watching!
backgroundError: The video background couldn’t resume. Try reloading it or choosing another video.

siteDomainNote: Anime Sama sometimes changes address. Pick a domain found on anime-sama.pw or type it yourself. Beware of fake sites (.com, .net…).

integrationNote: Checks at startup and every 24 hours, without changing your domain. The filter hides known ad slots; disable it if a player stops working. Popups stay blocked.
